catalog_governance.purpose: Read and render advisory catalog data without installation.
required: Validate source provenance and selection state.
Keep disabled candidates separate from canonical runnable pins.
Require explicit strict-origin mappings for all five repositories.
prohibited: Modify .system, vendor, or immutable legacy exports.
Treat readiness as true without independent benchmark, run, and acceptance evidence.

delivery.purpose: Make scoped changes with evidence appropriate to the task.
required: Identify the owning execution path before editing.
Use exact affected-route Browser validation when supported Browser capability is available.
Report material risks and blockers when present.
prohibited: Infer deployment or runtime proof from a green source or CI result.
Use finish-it language to expand into unrelated Git hygiene.
